items.title: U.S. Stocks to Extend Run of Double-Digit Earnings Growth
items.summary: Among the more than 440 S&P 500 companies reporting second-quarter earnings so far, 86% have beaten analysts’ estimates, according to FactSet data. The blockbuster earnings season has put the index on course for a seventh consecutive quarter of double-digit earnings growth.

items.title: S&P 500 Positive Profit Surprises Trending Above 5-Year Average
items.summary: With earnings season progressing, some 86% of S&P 500 companies have reported a positive profit-per-share surprise for the quarter, which is above the five-year average of 78%, according to John Butters, a senior earnings analyst from FactSet.  S&P 500 companies are exceeding their earning per share estimates for the second quarter by 29.2% in aggregate, which is above the five-year average of 7%, FactSet found.  The blended earnings growth rate for the quarter, which includes actual earnings and estimates for the index constituents is 50.4%, the highest growth rate since the second quarter 2021's 91.6%.

items.title: July jobs report reveals unexpected loss of 23,000 jobs
items.summary: Friday's jobs report showed employers shed jobs last month, rather than adding 95,000 new hires that had been forecast by economists.
